title: credential-ownership contract: name the GitHub App rung (ticks bundle re-cut, then adopt)
description: Epic dm6 built the App rung without touching contracts/credential-ownership.json, because it is VENDORED from pengelbrecht/ticks and digest-pinned (CONTRACTS.md: never edit it here). The closed ~/.ticfacrc schema names no App keys, so the rung records nothing new locally: the factory Worker is the record (GET /api/github/app) and ~/.ticfacrc keeps only factory_github_repo. To finish: in ticks, add factory_github_app_id, factory_github_app_slug, factory_github_app_installation_id (non-secret, stored_in ~/.ticfacrc) and 'app' to the factory_github_auth enum; declare the Worker-side stores (GITHUB_APP_SEALING_KEY secret; sealed private key + webhook secret in D1 table github_app; optional hand-set GITHUB_APP_ID/GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY/GITHUB_APP_SLUG secrets); cut a bundle version; then here: bump contracts.pin.json, go run ./cmd/contracts sync, add the Go constants to internal/factory/credentials + currentCredentialKeys, and have setupGitHubApp write the facts.
